author: MajestysDream
body:
I was in a game of Quintus, and as I was rushing, I decided to kill a player with full diamond, that turned out to be chrichri_c. I knocked him into the void, but since I turned out to be in front of him, he shot me into the void. As we were falling, he waited for me to die so that he could log. I found out he logged because I did not get my kill. Also, when I died from him, his name was the same color a spectator would have. You could see the picture linked below.  


http://gyazo.com/03ee5d449397c38591d5c51591fa2d0e
